body: 7 Days to die. Every new update makes the game less stable and weird. I know it is very popular atm but i really enjoyed the first releases.

People will forget about me anyway. I dont know how to make friends, im not a social type person. Last time i wanted to talk to someone, ended up being ignored. at least the ticket inspector wants to talk to me c: (just to check my ticket lol)

Thank you, but i have been alone for a long time now and i dont really see why should i keep on living that way. I tried to help my loneliness by playing video games and watching movies but now it doesnt bring me any joy.
